conditions.overall: Low water across WNC streams but fishing is great. DH streams received final spring stocking — next stocking not until October. Wild creeks producing well. Sulphur hatches now daily, transitioning out of caddis. Tailwaters fishing very well around generation pulses.

top_flies.name: Sulphur Dry
top_flies.note: Daily sulphur hatches now on wild water and tailwaters. Late afternoon into evening.

top_flies.name: Yellow Sally
top_flies.note: Entering yellow bug season. Fish riffles and pool tails late afternoon.

top_flies.name: Yellow Rubber Leg Stimulator
top_flies.note: DSO go-to for wild water on a dry dropper rig right now. Their top pick for yellow bug season.

top_flies.name: Frenchie
top_flies.note: Top subsurface pattern on both DH and wild water. Dead-drift near bottom.

top_flies.name: Sulphur Nymph
top_flies.note: Effective on wild water and tailwaters as a dropper. Fish before the evening hatch.

top_flies.name: Zebra Midge
top_flies.note: Still producing on DH water and tailwaters. Black first.

top_flies.name: Chubby Chernobyl
top_flies.note: Dry dropper anchor on DH water. Egg or Frenchie as the dropper.

tactics: Dry dropper rig over any indicator — low clear water demands stealth
5–6X tippet on wild water; avoid heavy tippet that spooks fish in low flows
Size down your dry fly — less commotion on the water on the cast
Tailwaters: fish after generation pulses as water is falling — fish are fired up
Watauga TN pulses: 7am–8am and 7pm–8pm; best fishing as water drops after pulse
South Holston pulses: typically 2am–3am, 10am–11am, 6pm–7pm — check TVA daily
DH water: final spring stocking done — fish are pressured, go smaller and more natural

waters.name: Watauga River (Valle Crucis DH)
waters.note: Artificials only, catch-and-release through June 5. Harvest opens June 6 — verify at ncwrc.gov. Final spring stocking complete. Sulphur hatch producing in evenings.

waters.name: Helton Creek (Ashe County DH)
waters.note: Stocked this week per DSO report. Fishing well with fresh fish in. Chubby Chernobyl dry dropper and egg patterns near bottom.

waters.name: Big Horse Creek / South Fork New River (DH)
waters.note: Final spring stocking completing next week per DSO. Good reports coming in.

waters.name: Wild Creeks (WNC freestone)
waters.note: Low but fishing well. Yellow Sally and Sulphur hatches picking up. 5–6X tippet, dry dropper, size down your dry.

waters.name: Watauga River TN (tailwater)
waters.note: Fishing very well. Two one-hour pulses: 7am–8am and 7pm–8pm. Best fishing as water falls after morning pulse. Check TVA before heading out.

waters.name: South Holston (tailwater)
waters.note: Three one-hour pulses: typically 2am–3am, 10am–11am, 6pm–7pm. Sulphur hatches building toward summer peak. Always check TVA generation schedule — changes without notice.

elevation_note: High Country streams (Boone area, 3,300–4,000 ft) run 1–2 weeks behind lower-elevation WNC. Sulphur timing here is late May into June — you're right in the middle of it now.
stocking_note: Final spring DH stocking complete for 2026. Next DH stockings: October and November. Setzer State Fish Hatchery still under renovation through 2028 — stocking volumes reduced. Check ncpaws.org for updates.
